name: Guardrails
description: Refuses dangerous commands and the reading of secrets before they run. You let one through once, in a click, from its tab.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs a hook before each call of a tool that runs a command or touches a file (Bash, PowerShell, Monitor, Read, Edit, Write, Grep and the others its README lists) that can refuse it, shows a tab listing the refusals, and keeps them with its one-time passes in the kit's own data folder.
